name: KY-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent McGarvey running with $1.8M cash on hand
Challenger Rodriquez has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to McGarvey: a D+10 district, incumbency, and a large cash advantage against a challenger with no visible fundraising. Markets agree, pricing his win at roughly 96%, so the forecast stays at Safe D.
model.watch: Any credible polling showing a single-digit race or a surge of outside spending for Rodriquez would warrant moving toward Likely D.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Morgan McGarvey, the Democratic incumbent, seeks another term in a Louisville-based district that leans Democratic by about ten points. He enters the general election with a strong financial position, having raised over $1.6 million and holding $1.8 million on hand, while Republican Maria Rodriquez has no reported fundraising or outside support.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give McGarvey roughly a 96% chance of winning. With the incumbent's advantages in money, name recognition, and district partisanship, the seat is rated Safe Democratic, with uncertainty mainly reflecting the absence of polling.
